insurers: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
candidate_insurer_pool.reason_for_reuse: Product #12 selected no product and Product #13 closed before Gate C; neither experiment acquired a selected product document, performed semantic review or read target clauses. The conservative neutral insurer pool therefore remains eligible for a new experiment apparatus without reopening either experiment.

candidate_product_pool_derivation_rule.rule: For each preregistered insurer, enumerate every distinct Health product identity candidate surfaced through official regulator and/or insurer product-index, filing-index, public-disclosure or equivalent governed identity sources that can be bound to an exact UIN or exact regulator product identifier during the frozen construction window. Do not stop after the first candidate or first eligible candidate.
required: full enumeration across all four preregistered insurers
deduplicate only by exact governed product identity/UIN binding
preserve every included and excluded candidate in the adjudication ledger
candidate discovery order may not affect membership
target-concept presence, target-clause content, semantic complexity and semantic fit may not affect candidate inclusion in the adjudication pool
forbidden: searching for copayment or waiting-period terms
excluding a product because target clauses appear absent or difficult
including a product because it appears likely to exercise existing semantics

eligibility_predicate.membership_rule: A candidate is ELIGIBLE only if every required predicate is positively established under the frozen evidence contract. Missing, conflicting or ambiguous required predicates yield INELIGIBLE_FAIL_CLOSED.

certification_evidence_contract.purpose: Establish non-target population membership independently of downstream semantic scoring.
allowed_authority_classes: IRDAI filing/index/return metadata keyed to product and UIN
insurer official product index or public-disclosure metadata
official insurer product page or configuration metadata for non-target purchase-scope facts
official filing cover sheet or product document when used only inside the separate certification stage to establish a frozen non-target predicate
every_attestation_requires: source_content_hash or immutable evidence hash where available
certification_evidence_contract.source_ref_proves_only: source identity/distinctness, never authority or truth by itself

eligible_universe_artifact_contract.eligible_selector_view: Only opaque_candidate_id values for candidates with ELIGIBLE status plus preregistered deterministic ordering inputs may be exposed to the selection step.

opaque_identifier_rule.derivation: SHA-256 over a canonical governed internal product-identity key with a fixed experiment namespace; raw product name, insurer name, UIN and URL must not be recoverable from the selector-visible string itself.

future_product14_selection_rule.future_rule: After the eligible-universe artifact and SHA-256 are frozen and separately authorized, sort selector-visible opaque eligible IDs ascending bytewise and select the first. No random seed, human choice, product substitution or selection override is permitted.

anti_bias_and_anti_contamination_control: candidate insurer pool frozen before certification
candidate product pool derivation rule frozen before certification
eligibility predicate frozen before candidate review
target concepts excluded from membership rule and selector output
exact-product prior-exposure audit remains mandatory after selection and before target review
target-clause reads remain zero until downstream authorization

stop_rule.statement: Product #14 is the final experiment in the current neutral-selection hardening cycle.
